reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS promo_orders
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
 AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00'
 AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_code
alternatives:
WITH order_flags AS (  -- one row per order placed in those two weeks
  SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_promo
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(f.order_id) AS n_orders, COALESCE(SUM(f.has_promo), 0) AS promo_orders
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN order_flags f ON f.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_code

SELECT s.store_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL) AS promo_orders
FROM stores AS s
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
 AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-16'
LEFT JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

solver.query:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_id FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
), po AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM order_lines WHERE promo_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.store_code,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(po.order_id) AS promo_orders
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN po ON po.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_code ASC
